## Solution

**Setup.** A standard die has even faces $\{2,4,6\}$ and odd faces $\{1,3,5\}$. On a player's turn, they win immediately if their roll is **even** or **equals any previously rolled face**. Thus the game can only continue past a turn if that turn's roll is an **odd number not yet seen**. Since there are only three odd faces, at most three "continuing" rolls are possible.

**Turn 1 — Kelvin.** He wins on an even roll: $P = \tfrac{3}{6} = \tfrac{1}{2}$. He continues only on an odd roll: $P = \tfrac{1}{2}$, leaving one odd face used.

**Turn 2 — Alex.** Given Kelvin rolled an odd $k\in\{1,3,5\}$, Alex wins if he rolls even ($\tfrac{3}{6}$) **or** rolls $k$ again ($\tfrac{1}{6}$). These events are disjoint (even $\neq$ odd), so
$$P(\text{Alex wins on turn 2}) = \tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\left(\tfrac{3}{6}+\tfrac{1}{6}\right) = \tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\tfrac{2}{3} = \tfrac{1}{3}.$$
Alex continues only by rolling a *different* odd face: $P = \tfrac{2}{6} = \tfrac{1}{3}$, so
$$P(\text{reach turn 3}) = \tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\tfrac{1}{3} = \tfrac{1}{6}.$$

**Turn 3 — Kelvin.** Two distinct odd faces are now used. Kelvin wins if he rolls even ($\tfrac{3}{6}$) or one of the two used odds ($\tfrac{2}{6}$), disjoint:
$$P(\text{Kelvin wins on turn 3}) = \tfrac{1}{6}\cdot\tfrac{5}{6} = \tfrac{5}{36}.$$
He continues only by rolling the **third** odd face: $P=\tfrac{1}{6}$, so
$$P(\text{reach turn 4}) = \tfrac{1}{6}\cdot\tfrac{1}{6} = \tfrac{1}{36}.$$

**Turn 4 — Alex.** All three odd faces are now used, so every roll is either even or a repeat. Alex wins with probability $1$:
$$P(\text{Alex wins on turn 4}) = \tfrac{1}{36}\cdot 1 = \tfrac{1}{36}.$$

**Total for Alex:**
$$P(\text{Alex wins}) = \tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{1}{36} = \tfrac{12}{36} + \tfrac{1}{36} = \boxed{\tfrac{13}{36}}.$$

**Check.** Kelvin's total: $\tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{5}{36} = \tfrac{18}{36}+\tfrac{5}{36} = \tfrac{23}{36}$, and $\tfrac{23}{36}+\tfrac{13}{36}=1$. ✓

P(Alex wins on turn 4) = P(reach turn 4) × 1 = 1/36.

P(Alex wins) = 1/3 + 1/36 = 12/36 + 1/36 = 13/36.

Let me verify P(Kelvin wins) = 1 - 13/36 = 23/36.

P(Kelvin wins on turn 1) = 1/2 = 18/36.
P(Kelvin wins on turn 3) = P(reach turn 3) × P(Kelvin wins on turn 3) = (1/6) × (5/6) = 5/36.

Total Kelvin = 18/36 + 5/36 = 23/36. ✓

Total = 23/36 + 13/36 = 36/36 = 1. ✓
